page.help: The language Mewvo uses in this server for posts and for DMs to members. Answers only one person sees follow that person's own Discord language.

card.title: Language
card.help: Pick the language for everything Mewvo posts in channels and sends to members by DM here. English is the default.

form.label: Language for posts and DMs
form.help: Members get punishment and appeal DMs in this language.
form.detected: Not chosen yet: Mewvo uses {language}, your server's language in Discord. Save to keep it.
form.notChosen: Not chosen yet: Mewvo uses English. Pick a language and save.

rule.title: Who sees which language
rule.public: Posts in channels and DMs to members: the language you pick here.
rule.private: Answers only one person sees (like error messages after a command): that person's own Discord language.
rule.done: Translated so far: punishment, unban/unmute and appeal DMs, and error messages. Everything else still shows in English for now.

saved.done: Mewvo now uses {language} for posts and DMs in this server.

roles.title: Language roles
roles.help: One role per language. A member with one of these roles gets messages meant for them (answers, DMs, level-ups, the counting notice) in that language; without one, the rules below apply. Members pick their role with /language set or the panel from /language panel. Each role must be safe to hand out (no staff permissions, below Mewvo's role).
roles.duplicate: {first} and {second} have the same role. Each language needs its own role.

refresh.title: Refresh posted messages
refresh.help: Rewrites the verification, ticket, appeal and reaction role panels Mewvo already posted, in the bot language above. Nothing is reposted, and text you typed yourself stays as it is. Mewvo also does this when you change the language.
refresh.auto: Posted panels are being updated to it.
